text:
The Royal Caribbean Group’s ships serve about 455 destinations on all seven continents.  
Dividing the total number of destinations by the number of continents gives an average:

\[
\frac{455\ \text{destinations}}{7\ \text{continents}} \approx 65\ \text{destinations per continent}
\]

**Answer:** Approximately 65 destinations per continent. [D16_C0]
